name: OpenClaw Fix Tests
description: Run the fixed OpenClaw test-repair flow with write scope and output verification.

steps.description: Verify the fixed test-repair flow is allowed with write scope
Execute the fixed OpenClaw test-repair flow within write scope
Validate the fixed flow output against the declared write scope

constraints: The flow id is fixed to fix-tests
Execution is fixed to write scope with no escalation
Outputs must pass OpenClaw verification before the recipe completes
invariants: No alternate OpenClaw flow can be substituted at runtime
No scope other than write is allowed for this recipe
A failed verification blocks recipe success
